Carrying one film's message across every linguistic boundary.

Studio 1947 collaborated with Local Futures to localize their educational video about the localization movement for global audiences. Our team created accurate, culturally-sensitive subtitles that made the content accessible to non-English speakers while preserving the original message's integrity and emotional resonance.

The result expanded the video's reach across linguistic boundaries, enabling Local Futures to connect with diverse communities worldwide and amplify their mission of promoting local economies and sustainable development.

Introduction

Local Futures is an international nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening community-based economies, challenging the harms of economic globalization, and advancing pathways toward ecological and social well-being. Founded in the 1970s, the organization works with grassroots groups, policymakers, educators, and citizens worldwide to promote localization — the shift toward economies that prioritize local production, cultural diversity, and democratic self-determination.

Through campaigns, films, publications, workshops, and advocacy, Local Futures seeks to inspire a future where communities thrive on their own terms while remaining connected to a global movement for change.

The Objective

The primary challenge was to localize a key educational video about localization so it could reach diverse global audiences while maintaining the authenticity and impact of the original message. The goal was to make the content accessible to non-English speakers without losing the cultural nuances and emotional resonance of the source material.

Our Process

01

Subtitling & Translation

  • Created accurate, culturally-sensitive subtitles in multiple languages
  • Ensured timing and readability matched the video's pacing
  • Preserved the tone and intent of the original narration
02

Quality Assurance

  • Reviewed translations for accuracy and natural flow
  • Verified that terminology aligned with Local Futures' messaging
  • Tested subtitles across different devices and platforms
03

Delivery

  • Provided finalized subtitle files compatible with YouTube's platform
  • Ensured proper encoding for international character sets
  • Delivered on schedule to support their campaign timeline

The Result

The localized video now enables Local Futures to:

  • Reach non-English speaking communities — viewers from diverse linguistic backgrounds can now engage with the content in their native language.
  • Maintain message integrity — the core message about localization remains clear and impactful across all language versions.
  • Increase engagement — subtitled videos typically see higher completion rates and broader sharing potential.
  • Support campaign goals — the accessible content helps amplify their mission to promote local economies and sustainable development.

Client Impact

Since adding localized subtitles, Local Futures has been able to:

  • Extend the life and reach of their educational content beyond English-speaking audiences.
  • Build stronger connections with international partners and communities.
  • Increase the accessibility of their important message about localization.
  • Maximize the return on investment for their video production efforts.

Why Studio 1947?

Studio 1947 brings expertise in cross-cultural communication and precise localization work. Our team understands the importance of preserving meaning, tone, and cultural context when translating content for global audiences. We're committed to helping organizations like Local Futures share their vital messages with the widest possible reach while maintaining authenticity and impact.
